# Offline audio transform and loudness

<!-- GENERATED BY xtask index render; DO NOT EDIT. -->

- Feature id: `feature/sim-music/offline-audio-transform-and-loudness`
- Subject: `crate/sim-lib-sound-render`
- Canonical key: `crate/sim-lib-sound-render/feature-sim-music-offline-audio-transform-and-loudness`

Stretch and pitch PCM independently through a policy-complete STFT phase vocoder, measure EBU R128/ITU-R BS.1770 loudness and true peak, normalize with visible gain and clipping evidence, and lower through bounded channel mapping and seeded PCM16 dither.
